output_list.criticism: The function does not properly check for integer overflow, allowing the preSale agent to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The function allows the team to transfer tokens from any user's balance, potentially leading to unauthorized token transfers.
Similar to transfer, this function allows the team to transfer tokens from any user's balance, compromising user funds.
The function allows the team to set the allowance for any spender, enabling potential unauthorized spending of user tokens.
Using a constant value for 'isFrozen' state makes it predictable and susceptible to attacks, as the team can control the freeze state.
